headline: Pillar 2 net gains exceed 100 billion lei
summary: Net gains of Romania's mandatory private pension funds reached 108.6 billion lei (20.7 billion euros) at the end of July 2026, the first time they exceeded 100 billion lei. The figure comes from the APAPR association's calculations.
why: Romania's Pillar 2 pension funds manage mandatory retirement savings, so their asset growth is a gauge of domestic capital markets and long-term institutional investment.
